title: Eloquent Logic Agent — feedback/notification events
description: Every liblogic feedback_listener callback fired while logic_agent (logic_agent/agent.cpp) handles a request is streamed to STDOUT ahead of the final Response, as a JSON-RPC 2.0 Notification object: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"<category>/<callbackName>","params":{...}} — one per line, no "id" field (logic_agent/rpc/event_sink.hpp). This is NOT an OpenRPC document: OpenRPC models request/response method pairs, and these are one-way, fire-and-forget notifications interleaved with a request's eventual Response, so they're catalogued here as plain JSON Schema instead. See openrpc.json for the 4 request/response methods (parse, transform, sat, truth_table) that produce this notification stream as a side effect. Every notification def below is named after the exact listener callback it mirrors and traces back to the streaming_*_listener.cpp file that emits it; use $defs.AnyFeedbackNotification to validate an arbitrary line of the stream without knowing its method name up front.

Uuid.title: Uuid
Uuid.description: JSON-serializable mirror of CppCommon::UUID (logic_agent/types/core/uuid_t.hpp): a bare string in canonical "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx" form, not a subobject.

Node.title: Node
Node.description: Mirrors eloquent::logic::Node (logic_agent/types/core/node_t.hpp). Children are referenced by uuid, not embedded recursively.

OptionalNode.description: A std::optional<node_t> field: the node, or null when the optional was empty (e.g. a NodeObsPtr that was null).

Cursor.title: Cursor
Cursor.description: Mirrors eloquent::logic::Cursor (logic_agent/types/parser/cursor_t.hpp): a snapshot of where the cursor sits plus the tree root it is building.

Literal.title: Literal
Literal.description: A DIMACS-style literal id (logic_agent/types/sat/common_t.hpp::literal_t, mirrors the library's Literal = int64_t). Negative = negated atom.

EmptyParams.title: EmptyParams
EmptyParams.description: Payload for a listener callback that carries no data (event_sink::emit_empty).

SingleLexemeEvent.description: logic_agent/types/parser/lexer_events.hpp::single_lexeme_event_t — wraps any callback carrying exactly one lexeme.

SingleNodeEvent.description: logic_agent/types/parser/cursor_events.hpp::single_node_event_t — wraps any callback carrying exactly one NodeObsPtr (cursor_listener_t::didTrySpawiningOverExistingNode, strict_parser_listener_t::didMakeNode/didPlaceNodeAtCursor/wrongArityForNode, relaxed_parser_listener_t::didMakeNewSubtree, node_transformation_listener_t's match/reduce/apply callbacks).

InvalidPositionEvent.description: logic_agent/types/parser/cursor_events.hpp::invalid_position_event_t — cursor_listener_t::didTryInvalidPosition(NodeObsPtr, size_t); index is the out-of-range child index the cursor tried to move to.

JoinEvent.description: logic_agent/types/parser/relaxed_parser_events.hpp::join_event_t — relaxed_parser_listener_t::didJoin(NodeObsPtr target, NodeObsPtr source); target is the node being grown, source is the subtree merged into it.

CondenseChildEvent.description: logic_agent/types/transformations/node_transformation_events.hpp::condense_child_event_t — node_transformation_listener_t::didCondenseChild(parent, merged); merged is the same-type child absorbed into parent.

NormalFormCheckEvent.description: logic_agent/types/transformations/node_transformation_events.hpp::normal_form_check_event_t — shared by node_transformation_listener_t::didCheckCNF(node, bool) and didCheckDNF(node, bool).

mapping.description: Atom name -> its DIMACS literal id.

ClauseSetEvent.description: logic_agent/types/sat/mapper_events.hpp::clause_set_event_t — mapper_listener::did_map_clauses(const ClauseSet&); also reused by sat_listener::didBuildHeuristicsDatabase(const ClauseSet&).

LiteralEvent.description: logic_agent/types/sat/sat_events.hpp::literal_event_t — shared by sat_listener::didFindUnitLiteral, didDeriveEmptyClauseFromUnitPropagation, didFindPureLiteral, didChooseRandomLiteral (all take a single Literal).

ClauseLiteralEvent.description: logic_agent/types/sat/sat_events.hpp::clause_literal_event_t — shared by sat_listener::didSatisfyClauseByUnitLiteral and didEliminateClauseByPureLiteral (both take a Clause and a Literal).

ClauseEvent.description: logic_agent/types/sat/sat_events.hpp::clause_event_t — shared by sat_listener::didSkipDuplicateResolvent and didAddResolvent (both take a single Clause).

BranchEvent.description: logic_agent/types/sat/sat_events.hpp::branch_event_t — shared by sat_listener::didEnterBranch and didPushBranchContext (both take a Literal and the truth value it was assigned).

Notification_mapper_did_map_literals.description: mapper_listener::did_map_literals(const std::map<std::string, Literal>&); emitted inline by sat_method.cpp's own clause-mapping step, matching streaming_mapper_listener.cpp's shape.

Notification_mapper_did_map_clauses.description: mapper_listener::did_map_clauses(const ClauseSet&); emitted inline by sat_method.cpp's own clause-mapping step, matching streaming_mapper_listener.cpp's shape.

AnyFeedbackNotification.description: Matches any single notification line logic_agent can stream, regardless of category. Validate one parsed JSON line at a time against this.
